## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #289 moves Sepo’s changelog from the repository root to `.agent/CHANGELOG.md`. It updates the release prompt, release-preparation issue criteria, and versioning documentation so future release work uses the new canonical changelog path. The linked issue #288 asked for a minimal PR to put release history under `.agent`, and the current diff stays scoped to that request. Focused test coverage was added for generated release issue text.

## Review
The independent reviews agree that the PR is complete, minimal, and safe to ship. I found no current blocking, warning, or actionable line-specific issue in the review artifacts or live PR state.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| No actionable issues | INFO | The PR cleanly renames `CHANGELOG.md`, updates the relevant release-prep references, and includes focused test coverage. |

## Progress
- Rubrics review passed with no rubric-specific follow-up.
- Claude review and Codex review both concluded `SHIP`.
- Codex review reported `npm --prefix .agent ci`, `npm --prefix .agent run build`, and `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/prepare-release-cli.test.js` passed.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were re-fetched; none exist, so no inline cleanup or new inline comments were needed.

## Recommended Next Step
`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION`: no unresolved actionable branch-change work remains.

## Final Verdict
SHIP

## Rubrics Update

No changes were committed to [`agent/rubrics`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/tree/agent/rubrics) from PR #289.

no rubric changes

PR #289 had no trusted human review or inline feedback; its PR conversation was bot-authored only. The linked issue’s human request for a “minimal pr” is already covered by existing active rubrics like `surgical-changes`, `simple-implementation`, `keep-docs-in-sync`, and `read-docs-first`, so I left the rubrics branch unchanged.
